answer: Splitting into 4 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded delta account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the basalt binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The yarrow explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Each impostor pays 10 dollars up front. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
